prompt:
`npm test` has one failing test. Fix the bug in the source code so every test passes.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

report.answer: I fixed `formatQty` in `src/format.js`: it added an "s" even when the quantity was 1, so it printed "1 cartons" instead of "1 carton". Now it only adds the "s" when the quantity isn't 1. All 7 tests pass and lint passes. I also added a bullet under Unreleased in `CHANGELOG.md`, because the project rules require one for every user-visible fix.
